title: Cyber Warfare: The Mouth Of The Beast

sense.text:
“Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them”: God is going to stir up the Medes against the United States of America, Babylon. The Medes are the Persians and the Medes, modern-day Iran. Before the 70s Iran was always known as Persia; in the 70s they changed the name to Iran. Persia is one of the four beasts the scripture says would rise up and rule the earth: the second counting from Babylon, the third counting back down.

Why would they be stirred up against America? They are going to be angry for all the bombs and the warfare, the destroying of their economy, all the things America and Israel are doing to them. Right now the US Navy is over there in West Asia, and America is about to attack Iran again and bomb the hell out of them. Not war but annihilation. Everything America is doing is preparing the nations for war and getting the nations mad. Right now America and Israel are trying to back a coup to overthrow the Iran regime. In the years ahead Iran will be under heavy sanctions and bombed a lot by the United States, and they will build up a rage against the United States. This is Bible prophecy.

“Which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it”: they are not going to care about money, and they are not going to care about gold.

We don’t give a crap about them Arabs or the Iranians. Them people enslaved us, and God is bringing judgment on them. God is using America to judge the Arabs and the Persians; America is the hammer of God. But in the end, the same cup America is pouring on them is going to be poured on America.

“They shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb”: that is the kids. “Their eye shall not spare children”: they are going to kill even children.

This is the third woe the Bible speaks of. It is going to start in the land of Israel, modern-day Israel, and then America is going to be destroyed also. It ends with America being destroyed.

“And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms”: the glory of kingdoms is Babylon, which is America. It “shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah”: that is nuclear destruction. That is how this place is going to be.

So everything going on right now is preparation: they are getting the Persians and the Medes angry and mad. But the ones who set it off will not be Iran. It will be the Arabs.

precepts.why:
Ezra sees what is going to happen: “Behold an horrible vision, and the appearance thereof from the east: Where the nations of the dragons of Arabia shall come out with many chariots, and the multitude of them shall be carried as the wind upon earth.” The dragons of Arabia are the Arabs, the sons of Ishmael. They are the ones who will fully set it off, against the Israelis in the land over there.

“Also the Carmanians raging in wrath shall go forth as the wild boars of the wood.” The Carmanians are Iran, the Persians: the same Medes God said he would stir up in Isaiah 13. Why are they raging in wrath? Because of all the oppression, the sanctions, the bombing of their cities, the killing of their leaders. All these things are going to happen.

America is about to turn it up on everyone on this earth, including us. America is about to turn up affliction upon this earth, and it is going to get worse and worse, like a woman in travail.

Look at what is happening now. Trump declared a national emergency over Cuba and put tariffs on any country that sells oil to Cuba, to collapse the Cuban economy: no oil, no gas. They did not oust Maduro of Venezuela; they went to his country and kidnapped him, and they took his wife too as a bargaining chip. That is how this devil thinks. When they came for Peter, they killed Peter’s wife with him. Every man has a weakness, and sometimes the weakness is his wife: put a gun to her head and he will sign whatever they want. This man is the oppressor and he ain’t playing no game.

Everything Trump is doing is fulfilling Bible prophecy. Dropping bombs on the Persians and killing their leaders, America and Israel are making the nations angry and mad. Things are speeding up. This is not the time to be in la-la land or in the midst of sin; it is the time to prepare ourselves and get our spirit right for what is about to take place on this earth.

sense.text:
“Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith”: that is our job, to exhort you to continue in the faith, to continue in this truth and this walk. Don’t let nothing take you out of this truth.

“And that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.” Through much tribulation we are going to enter into the kingdom. The tribulation has not fully started yet. You see it on a certain scale, but it will intensify. It is going to get worse, and worse, and worse.

Tribulation is not just losing a little job. It is attacks from the government: the government labeling us a hate group, putting us in prison, lying on us. In the end they will even force idol worship: if we don’t worship the beast, you can’t buy, you can’t sell, you can’t work, you can’t get a job, you can’t go to the doctor. They will hit you where it hurts: your pocket, lack of food, and your family, your wife and your children, because those are the things we care about. The tribulation is the hard things that come to make you dishonour the commandment of God.

Brothers, if you are not studying, not applying the scriptures, you have no roots, and you are not going to survive that tribulation. You will be offended and scared and run like a little girl when things get real. If you are fake and phony, or you come here as if it is just a little get-together, you will not be here too long.

Sisters, if you are single and looking for a husband, and the brother you like is not putting in, not teaching the scriptures, you ain’t seen no camp video with him, don’t marry that brother. That is a gamble. When things get real he is going back into the world, and then what are you going to do?

precepts.why:
“Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion”: the Bible says to be in pain. Pain is coming, and it has already begun; pay attention to what Trump and these people are doing. But whatever pain you go through, you still have to labour. You have to be labouring in this truth.

“Like a woman in travail”: the pain comes and it goes, and when the baby is close to coming, the pains increase and get worse and worse. That is what we see taking place right now. Whether this world has another ten years or twenty, as the time draws nearer the pains will increase: the affliction that will rise up against those of us that fear God.

“For now shalt thou go forth out of the city, and thou shalt dwell in the field, and thou shalt go even to Babylon.” Where are we living today? Babylon. Mystery Babylon the Great, the United States of America. This is the much tribulation we must go through to enter the kingdom.

“And the dragon was wroth with the woman”: the dragon is the beast, the white man, Esau. According to the prophecy, they will be angry at us. “And went to make war with the remnant of her seed”: they will make war with us.

“Which keep the commandments of God”: the reason they make war with us is not because we are evil or doing anything evil or are terrorists. It is because we keep the commandments of God.

“And have the testimony of Jesus Christ.” The testimony of Jesus Christ is everything written in this book, everything the prophets spoke and said is going to happen. That testimony says these people are the synagogue of Satan. It says who the wicked is, who the so-called white man is today, and all the evil he is going to do, and that God is bringing judgment on them for all the evil they are doing on this earth. As you teach those testimonies, he gets angry, and he makes war with us.

So brothers and sisters, do not think we are going to be out there teaching the Bible and everything is going to be good. The dragon is wroth, and he is going to make war with us. That is the much tribulation.

sense.text:
Cyber warfare: the mouth of the beast. The beast is Edom, the so-called white man, the fourth beast. The Bible speaks of social media, the internet, and all this technology everybody is using today.

“Behold a fourth beast”: the fourth kingdom to rise up and rule this earth. That fourth beast began with Rome, then Europe, and America is an extension of Rome. “It was diverse from all the beasts that were before it”: it was different from all the beasts before it.

“And it had ten horns.” When the European Union was founded it was ten countries; today it is twenty-seven or more. The ten horns are all white people, the Europeans, the people that will rule the earth. It is not talking about dark nations.

“There came up among them another little horn”: the little horn that came up among those ten horns is America. “Before whom there were three of the first horns plucked up by the roots”: three of the first horns fell in the wars America fought for its independence. America had to fight the French, Spain and Britain. This year America will be 250 years old.

“In this horn were eyes like the eyes of man.” Look at the back of the dollar bill: the eye of a man, set apart from the rest of the pyramid in the shape of a horn, with light illuminating all around it. It looks a little like the all-seeing eye of Ra, the Egyptian god, but they literally put the eyes of a man there. That eye represents wisdom: this man’s wisdom and his technology. It also means he sees everything. When you look at the TV, that is his eyes looking at you; when you look at your phone, it is his eyes. He controls everything through the media.

“And a mouth speaking great things.” The great mouth is not him speaking loud. A mouth is what you use to communicate, and Esau created a technology where he can speak from one side of the world to the other, to everyone in the world. That is the great mouth.

It started with the telegram, the first generation. Then the telephone; then the flip phone and dial-up internet; then 4G, when the phone turned into a little computer; then 5G and the AI. The radio was invented by Nikola Tesla, changing your voice into an electronic signal that goes to a receiver and changes back so people can hear you: some witchcraft. The radio is what told everybody during World War II who won what battle. Philo Farnsworth invented the television in America in 1928. The internet got its start in the United States in the late 1960s as a military defense system in the Cold War. Who invented the television, the airplane? Who first went to the moon, who first made the nuclear bomb? America. That is his wisdom.

The mouth kept evolving: telegram, radio, television, internet, and now social media, TikTok, YouTube. Nobody even watches the news no more; social media took over the news. They made the phones cheap, unlimited data for forty dollars a month, where years ago you paid a hundred and fifty for five hundred minutes, and then they set up Instagram, Facebook and TikTok. Why? Because that great mouth is used to monitor us, to control us, and to deceive the masses.

Now they say it openly. They say they need to control all the social platforms and authenticate every person who speaks online. Netanyahu said they have to use the tools of battle, that the weapons change over time, and that the most important purchases are TikTok and X; they have to talk to Elon. Another of them said social media is the new battlefield, where they must counter with their own weapons. They have bought TikTok, at least the part in America, and its new head says calling someone a Zionist is hate speech and that Jewish organizations feed them intelligence. They call social media a weapon. Whoever has power over the media has power over the mind of the masses, and they understand that. When the world saw on TikTok what they were doing in the land of Israel, killing babies, after they had shut down the press and killed the reporters there, they decided to own the platforms. But the Most High is a mastermind. They think they have the best technology; the Lord says, I got the best technology, seven angels able to do things no man can see. What they create, the Lord will allow them to use upon their own selves, their children, their wives and their families.

So social media is the mouth of the beast. It was set up to monitor you, control you and deceive you. Our people think it is just something to keep them occupied, but it is war.

precepts.why:
Daniel asks to know “the truth of the fourth beast, which was diverse from all the others, exceeding dreadful, whose teeth were of iron, and his nails of brass”. Then “of the ten horns that were in his head, and of the other which came up”: the other that came up is America, “and before whom three fell”.

“Even of that horn that had eyes, and a mouth that spake very great things, whose look was more stout than his fellows.” More stout means stronger. America is stronger than all the European nations. Why? Because of the technology: that great mouth, and those eyes, the wisdom Satan gave him to create technology. Those eyes also go into his military, the strength he has.

The great things he speaks: he calls himself the people of God. He calls himself a Jew. He says the land of Israel belongs to him. He sets himself up as God. America has spoken many great things against God.

Hear the man himself: the United States is the most powerful nation on earth, it spends more on its military than the next eight nations combined, no nation attacks it because they know that is the path to ruin. See how arrogant they are. They think nobody can bring them down: they have the best army, the best soldiers, the best guns, the best witchcraft. That is the look more stout than his fellows, and the mouth speaking great things.

The eyes of a man in that horn go into his wisdom and his technology. “Son of man, say unto the prince of Tyrus”: Tyrus was a very rich ancient city on the coast of Lebanon, and God is using Tyrus as an analogy for America today.

“Because thine heart is lifted up, and thou hast said, I am a God, I sit in the seat of God, in the midst of the seas”: this is what America said. They set themselves up as the people of God and make God look like them, and because of their technology they think they are gods. This is what the white man thinks. But God says, “yet thou art a man, and not God, though thou set thine heart as the heart of God.” The white man is not God.

“Behold, thou art wiser than Daniel.” Daniel could tell a man what he dreamed, but the technology they have is on another level: I can talk with somebody on the other side of the world and we can see each other on a device. “There is no secret that they can hide from thee.” One of the characteristics of God is that he sees everything everyone does. The white man set himself up as God and says, I see everything. That is the eye on the dollar. Every evil you do, every time you go on Pornhub, everything you buy, all the skeletons in your closet, he knows. He knows you better than you know yourself.

If the technology they let us know about can already tell what shirt a man is wearing, then what they really have knows everything you do inside your house: every media you check, your family, everything. The Lord allowed him, through his media and the demonic spirit on him, to see everything people do. That is why he will be deceived at the last day, thinking he has all the information.

“With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches”: that is how America became rich, through its technology. “By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches”: traffick is trade. Everybody wants to come to America. It took much wisdom to set up SWIFT, the system nations use to trade money, and the IMF, and to make the American dollar the dominant dollar in the world. “And thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches.”

“Because thou hast set thine heart as the heart of God”: they put themselves up as God and say, we can see anything any of you are doing. Therefore God says, “I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations: and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom.” That is future prophecy.

“Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air.” You might say that is Satan. But who has power over the radio waves that transmit through the air? Esau.

We always forget about his children. When the Bible says Satan or the devil, it is not just talking about the spiritual demon; it is talking about his children too. Who has power on this earth and is deceiving everyone on this earth? Esau. And who is working in him to do it? Satan.

So the prince of the power of the air is the great mouth. The electronic waves and transmissions all go through the air, and the white man has power over that. That is the horn with the eyes, that wisdom, and the mouth speaking great things.

sense.text: Here is that horn coming into power, and the great mouth he has. “Another beast coming up out of the earth” is America, and “he had two horns like a lamb”: the two horns are the Democrats and the Republicans.

“And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him”: the first beast is Rome. The same power Rome had, America has. “And causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast”: the whole earth worships Rome. The religion you follow, you got from Rome: Christianity. “Whose deadly wound was healed”: Rome fell, and it came back during the Renaissance.

“And he doeth great wonders”: those great wonders go back to the horn in Daniel 7 that had the eyes of a man. That is his wisdom, his technology, his scientific inventions. What did he invent? The atom bomb. “So that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men”: this is World War II. The Bible documented America dropping that bomb on Japan.

“And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles”: Esau uses his technology to deceive people. America has used this technology to deceive the world.

“That they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live”: they took the image from Rome. That is where they got the image from.

“And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast.” What is that power? His technology, his mouth. It began with the radio and with Hollywood, all these movies. How many of us grew up watching, every Easter, a white man being whipped? That power is Hollywood, television, the internet and social media.

“That the image of the beast should both speak.” What is an image? A picture of something. John the Revelator saw a vision of white people speaking as if they are Christ. He saw the white man’s image on a screen, talking: the same way you see my image and hear me speaking right now on the television, or online all around the world. The prophets saw the future and explained what they saw the best way they could. Through those images, those movies and social media, billions of people worship Christ as a white man. The life he gave to that image is the life of Christ. Who had power to do that? The white man, and America took it to another level with Hollywood.

“And cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.” This is the future. John the Revelator saw us, the prophets, being killed here in America in the last days, because we will not worship the white man as Christ and God and Saviour.
This is Esau. “He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.”
“His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud”: the white man’s mouth is full of cursing, deceit and fraud. “Under his tongue is mischief and vanity.”

“He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places”: that is the Mossad and the CIA. “Doth he murder the innocent”: that is the black sites. They will put us in black sites and kill us.

“His eyes are privily set against the poor.” Remember what social media was set up for: to monitor us. Those are the white man’s eyes on the back of the dollar bill, his technology, his surveillance system, set against us. As Ezekiel said, there is no secret you can hide from him. Every porn video you watch, every site you go on, everything you do, the white man knows.

They are telling us themselves. The police have a tool to watch your phone in real time as you type and send messages. The Israeli company NSO made Pegasus, which could get into your phone, take your photos and messages, and watch and listen to you through your own camera and microphone, and now Paragon’s Graphite, as powerful or more, is approved for Homeland Security. It is a dragnet: you are at a coffee shop and they are collecting your data. There is an AI threat detection platform for law enforcement that scrapes the internet 24/7 and never sleeps. Palantir in the police car shows your bank accounts, and Flock cameras at every intersection read your license plate and track everywhere you go. Israel is turning Samsung phones into surveillance devices that know your location, your fingerprint, every text, call and search. Israel has bought Google and YouTube results so that when you search religious or political questions you get what Israel wants you to see. Groups say they monitor us 24 hours a day, seven days a week, on social media, messaging apps, video games and podcasts, and share it with the FBI. Your smart television and the cameras in your house can be hacked to see what is going on in your house. Whatever you visited online never leaves.

They watch us too. The Times of Israel asked how many Hebrew Israelites there are and how worried the Jews should be. They watched Bishop’s account and quoted his post, and tried to tie us in with attacks that had nothing to do with any Israelite congregation. From the census and their surveys they number us: about 1.6 million who identify as Israelites, and 7.8 million who agree with what we teach. How do they know these numbers? YouTube, the algorithms, everybody who watches our videos. That is why they came down so hard on Kyrie Irving and took the billions from Kanye until he apologized: they have been trying to hide this truth so long.

So brothers and sisters, stop putting your private and personal business on social media: where you are, your kids, you and your husband in Jamaica. Those who like it and friend you are not your real friends; they are watching you. Brothers watching porn, watching what you are not supposed to be watching: Esau sees you. God sees you, but the white man sees you too, and eventually he is going to come for you. If you are not using it to put the truth out there, delete it.

“He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor”: he wants to catch us slipping, to catch you clicking on the wrong thing. He monitors your bank accounts too; the ADL monitors bank accounts, and the cops can see your bank account and all your information. Everything is coming under one system. “He doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.”
“He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones”: his strong ones are the government, the police, the military.

precepts.why:
“The wicked watcheth the righteous”: brothers and sisters, they are watching you. That system they have set up can tell everything you are doing, so you have to walk right and be an example. They are watching those of us who keep the commandments, those of us who call ourselves Israelites.

“And seeketh to slay him”: that is what they want to do. They want to destroy us.

“Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.” All their thoughts are against us for evil.

“They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps”: they watch where you go. That new system can tell everywhere you go. If you download TikTok now, you have to agree to terms where they can check your immigration status and follow wherever you go. Those new terms are set up to monitor you and follow you: they mark your steps.

“When they wait for my soul”: they want to destroy our soul.

The same thing Christ went through is the same thing we are going to go through today. “And they watched him”: they were watching Christ, the same way they watch us through these devices. Why do you think they let our channels stay up on YouTube? So they can monitor us.

“And sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men”: men acting like they are righteous. They are going to send brothers and sisters among us to watch us. They did it in France: there were agents among the brothers, and certain conversations the brothers had among themselves ended up in the court case when they kicked the brother out of the country. You come among us acting like you want to learn and better your life, but you were sent by the federal government to set us up, to plant something on us and lie on us. The same thing they did to Christ. We do our job, because they know how to hide themselves.

“That they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor”: they want to record you, take hold of your words and deliver them to the government. That is why anything you say has to be scriptural. None of you should be saying dumb, stupid stuff.

And whoever chooses that kind of work condemns himself. For what, a little house, a little bank account, the US dollar that don’t mean nothing? You condemn your soul forever.

sense.text: “But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost.” If you don’t understand that Christ is a black man, that the children of the transatlantic slave trade are the Jews according to the Bible, and that Christ is coming to bring vengeance on all the nations that oppressed us, it is because you are lost.

“In whom the god of this world”: who is the god of this world? The white man, the one that sees all things. Some people say it is the spiritual demon, Satan, but you always have to start with his physical counterpart, the so-called white man. He is the one creating all these technologies; he is the one who deceived the world physically.

“Hath blinded the minds of them which believe not.” How did he blind your mind? With his mouth: his technology, that great mouth speaking lies and blasphemy. As Revelation 13 says, he made the image of the beast to speak, and you believed that stuff. The white man is the one who deceived you, lied to you, and told you to worship him.

precepts.why:
“Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan”: that is America. America’s coming into power is after the working of the spiritual demon, Satan. “With all power and signs and lying wonders”: what is that called today? Technology, the media, social media.

“And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish.” How will our people be deceived? Through technology and social media. “Because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.” You did not love this truth. You love the white man and the white man’s lies, and you hate yourself.

“And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion.” A delusion is a false belief about external reality, held despite incontrovertible evidence to the contrary. We give them the evidence that Christ is black and that we are the Jews according to the Bible, and it doesn’t matter: the white man’s strong delusion is stronger. Our people who follow Christianity, who believe the people in the land of Israel are the Jews, are under a strong delusion. They came under it through the technology, the mouth of the beast. America, the Israeli government and Europe have our people under it, and they cannot come up out of it unless God opens their eyes. So God is allowing America to do some crazy things on this earth, and he is using that to wake his people up and break the spell of that strong delusion.

“That they should believe a lie.” The white man being a Jew: that is a lie; Christ called them the synagogue of Satan. White people being the Christians: a lie; the Christians were the Israelites who converted and followed Christ. That you can eat pork and shrimp: a lie. That Christ came and died for all nations: a lie.

“That they all might be damned who believed not the truth.” Everyone who does not believe this truth is going to be damned, with no repentance. You can curse us and call us names. It is what it is.

“For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets”: that is Christianity, what you see today. The image of the beast, the white man, coming and speaking lies in Christ’s name.

“And shall shew great signs and wonders”: what are those signs and wonders? His technology, his mouth: television, Hollywood movies, all that stuff. Captain America, GI Joe, the Avengers that we grew up watching: those things were brainwashing us, putting up white people as heroes. These things mess with your mind.

“Insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.” Is it possible for them to deceive the elect? No. The delusion is so strong that if it were possible, it would even have got the elect. But it is not possible. That is why we are waking up today, understanding these things and seeing clearly. They can’t trick us; we are not under that delusion. But the whole world is under it.

sense.text:
Netanyahu and the Israeli government want to stop the truth from going forth. They call social media a new kind of warfare, and they are going to try to block our videos and take us down off social media. They have done it before: years ago they took down our YouTube pages, and they told us they could go into a page and see what we were doing even when it was made private. Soon we will not be on YouTube teaching no more. But see what God says about it.

“He disappointeth the devices of the crafty”: the devices he has set up, God is going to disappoint. “So that their hands cannot perform their enterprise”: all the things they want to do against us, their hands will not be able to perform.

“He taketh the wise in their own craftiness”: the traps they have set up, God says, I am going to take them in their own craftiness. “And the counsel of the froward is carried headlong”: their counsel is going to be destroyed.

“But he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth.” God is going to save us from their mouth. What is their mouth? Their media, their technology, all the lies they put out in their media about us. The Lord says he is going to destroy that.
“So the poor hath hope, and iniquity stoppeth her mouth.” There is a mystery of iniquity, and her mouth is going to be shut. They are going to shut the damn mouth.

“Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words”: bitter words are lies. They call us a hate group; they say we kill people. All kinds of lies they put out there against us.
“That they may shoot in secret at the perfect”: they want to shoot at us in secret.

“They commune of laying snares privily”: they set traps secretly. These laws they are putting in place are really traps for us: say something, and they call it anti-Semitic, and you go to jail for that. “They say, Who shall see them?”

“They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search.” Many times we have explained this as them digging up the past and bringing it forward to today, like the Christmas tree. That is true. But remember Ezekiel 28: there is no secret that can be hid from him.

Did they know every evil thing Martin Luther King did? All the adultery, they knew it. It is the same with us. They can go through your phone, come through your television and your laptop, and spy on you. Why? They are looking for your weakness. “Both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.” When they lock you up on trumped-up charges, the first thing they say is, he did this twenty years ago, he did this ten years ago. With these devices they can tell what sins you are dealing with. There is no secret you can hide from them.
“But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.”

“So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves.” What is their tongue? Their media, social media: that is how they speak. And their tongue is falling upon themselves through social media. They start telling on each other; there is a bunch of whistleblowers. Europeans are saying, what you are doing over there in the land of Israel is wrong.

Because that is happening, they say we need to take control, we need TikTok and X, we have to fight the warfare. But they are not going to be able to change nothing.

precepts.why:
Their own tongue shall fall upon them. “And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate the whore”: the ten horns are Europe, and they are going to hate America. “And shall make her desolate”: they will destroy this place.

“And naked”: to make her naked is to expose her, her sins and her shame showing. A lot of the evil America and Europe did together is going to be exposed. You see it happening today: Europe saying, you are wrong for what Israel did in Palestine, killing all these kids, and bringing charges and putting a warrant out for Netanyahu’s arrest for war crimes. Europe will reveal a lot of the evil America is doing. That is their own tongue falling upon themselves.

sense.text:
This is talking about America being destroyed. “He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through. It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall: terrors are upon him.”

“A fire not blown shall consume him”: a fire not blown is the nuclear bomb, because you don’t have to fan that fire for it to burn. It shall consume this place, America. “It shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle”: with him that is left here in America.

“The heaven shall reveal his iniquity.” It starts with us: as we teach the word of God, the angels make things happen.
